span.p: Welcome. More connections can be added later

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: How do you want to pay for AI?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pick a plan provider. Every tile says what it spends
A plan is not an API key. ChatGPT, Copilot, Cursor
and Gemini CLI spend that plan's allowance. Claude: API key only
OpenRouter and pasted keys spend per token
Plus is about 11 to 14 times API-equivalent. An estimate, not a quota

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Pasted key, or OpenRouter?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ollama or LM Studio
GET /api/tags. Flag missing tools or a small context
Spends this computer's time. Our own loop
Slots sized to VRAM, not money

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Official route only. No copied tokens, no pretended client, no password
OpenAI: Sign in with ChatGPT, PKCE in the system browser,
stable ext_agent_host_id, scope chatgpt.tokens.use.direct.
Spends Plus or Pro. Our Responses loop, or Codex app-server
Copilot: GitHub device code, or the existing CLI login.
Premium requests. SDK or copilot --acp. getQuota shows remaining percent
Cursor: browser login mints a 90-day key, or a pasted dashboard key.
Plan pool, then on-demand only if the user enabled it. SDK or ACP
Anthropic: no plan route in v1. Its terms forbid storing or intermediating
Claude subscription tokens. Console API key, in our loop or in Claude Code
Google: no third-party plan login, ever. API key, or unmodified gemini --acp.
Off by default. Antigravity is not offered. Never read ~/.gemini

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Which connection was just made?

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: One tiny test turn. The guide shows that provider's own steps

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Was chatgpt.tokens.use.direct granted?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Keep the sign-in. Plan usage stays disabled
Offer retry, or an API key

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Prefix detects the provider. Model-list call spends no tokens
OS vault. Link to the provider's own spend limit

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PKCE on a loopback callback mints a user key
Spends credits per token. Our loop. Suggest a credit limit

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Suggested roster: Manager, Senior, Mid, Junior
Each slot names connection, model and effort. Editable

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Dollar budget for pay-per-token work
Plan share per plan. Default: half the weekly allowance
Paid fallback off unless set in advance, with a dollar cap
Alerts at 50, 80 and 95 percent. Then the folder picker

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Settings: label, account, status, what it spends,
this week's use, roles. Add, test, rename, reconnect,
rotate, edit limits, disable, remove, reorder fallback.
The same provider may appear twice. Roster edits hit new attempts only

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ships first as an open-source app that runs locally
ChatGPT plan use is self-serve. A paid or hosted edition
needs OpenAI's interest form. Gemini CLI ships in v1,
off by default, with a policy warning. The Claude plan route is withdrawn
Routes live in a versioned provider policy file

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Who runs the loop?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Model mode. Our worker loop executes every tool call

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Agent mode. Their agent, in a worktree we create
ACP, or the native protocol where it shows more, over stdio
A visible terminal is only for the user's own login

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Normalized events: session, turn, plan, tool, permission,
file, question, subagent, usage, rate limit, error
message.delta is display only and never decides

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
The kernel matches events to the brief. No watching model
Allow only the brief's path globs and the command list
Deny push, branch switches, reset --hard, network installers,
deletes outside the worktree, vault paths and credential files
Stop at the reservation, the time cap, a repeated identical call,
or the same failing command three times
Silence for the stall window: interrupt, checkpoint, possibly stuck
Defense in depth: their sandbox, our answers, the Job Object, then the diff

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ACP or the native protocol is how we control them
A per-attempt MCP server is how they talk to us:
get_brief, read_result, ask_owner, dispute_test,
report_progress, request_dependency, submit_candidate

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Git diff is the truth. Files outside scope reject the candidate

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Clean verifier runs the locked checks, including a held-back case
The agent's own 'tests passed' does not count

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
When our side needs a judgment: one structured turn,
tools off, a JSON schema, validated like any other output

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
One Copilot task, as specified
1 Worktree, brief, copilot --acp, harness MCP
2 Send the brief. plan.updated is display only
3 In-scope write: allow. curl piped to sh: deny and record
4 ask_owner: the task author answers from the record
5 submit_candidate: snapshot the diff
6 Verifier pass accepts and unlocks dependents

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
One reservation rule for two currencies
Project, feature, task, attempt
usd, allowance for that connection, optional local slots
Must fit every ancestor, in one SQLite transaction

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Estimate tokens, then allowance points
If used-percent is reported: k is delta percent over tokens,
reserve tokens times k times 1.3
ChatGPT plan rejects max_output_tokens: reserve a per-role
worst case, then settle from reported usage
If nothing is reported: a labeled weekly token budget.
The real stop is the provider's limit error

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
One controller per plan connection, in the global broker,
because projects share plans. Grant, deposit, reserve, dispatch. AIMD from TCP:
start at 2, add one after clean turns, halve on throttle,
wait for the retry hint. User cap and plan-tier cap apply
Burn rate: remaining share divided by time until reset
If the share would run out early, slow that connection,
move junior tasks, and show the new ETA

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: What stopped the call?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Backoff. Not a worker failure

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Checkpoint. Waiting for allowance
Resume at reset only if the user enabled it

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Paid fallback was turned on in advance?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Continue on that paid connection

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Stay paused. No silent switch to paid

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Show a remainder only when that route reported it
API keys: tokens, and dollars from the price table
ChatGPT plan tokens: no remaining-allowance endpoint
Codex rate limits: local open-source clients only
Claude: full percent only near a threshold
Copilot getQuota: remaining percent and reset
Gemini: quota errors only. Cursor remainder: the dashboard
Otherwise say estimated, and name the basis

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
OS vault. SQLite stores a reference. Tokens stay in memory
Redactor masks vault values in prompts, logs and exports
A foreign agent gets credentials only from its own login,
or from a per-process environment variable

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
On startup and after a CLI version change: conformance suite
Denied write, allowed edit, allowed command, interrupt, resume, usage
A failed step becomes observe-only or disabled
Unknown events are logged and ignored. Minimum versions are pinned

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Refresh fails, or the user disconnects the app: hold that
connection, show Reconnect, keep the others running
Pro downgraded to Plus: the five-hour window applies
Same plan also in chat: leave headroom, trust the limit error
Two machines: warn that the estimate may be low
Model gone: fall back and note it. Outage: re-route only
within the allowed tier and spend type. 401: rotate the key
A policy change disables the route and parks its tasks

svg.text: Onboarding, plan versus API, and supervising a provider agent
